hook.name: LodeHook
hook.description: LodeHook charges a 1% fee on the ETH leg of every swap, routing 80% into a shared jackpot ("vein") and 20% to the deployer. Each swap simultaneously rolls for a "strike" using block.prevrandao-based randomness — winning half the vein — with Bitcoin-style difficulty retargeting. Winnings are credited to tx.origin via ERC-6909 claims inside the PoolManager and withdrawn via a pull claim function.
